observations: A used transmission housing and gear assembly.
The housing is a large, vertical metal casing with a prominent gear box section.
The exterior surface shows significant rust and corrosion, especially on the top and sides.
The housing is surrounded by numerous hoses, wires, and other mechanical components.
The interior of the housing is not visible, so the condition of the internal gears and shafts cannot be determined.
The image contains a watermark for 'FASHION JIJI'.
A timestamp '22/07/2024 12:45' is visible in the bottom left corner.
